page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-384-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is equipped with 3024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 7.88 GB per vCPU. It does not include any graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and local storage is not configured in the primary storage specification.

This instance provides a high density of compute and memory resources within a single virtual machine. Because it features dedicated CPU allocation, workloads are isolated from noisy-neighbor effects, ensuring consistent execution times. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of 384 vCPUs and over three terabytes of RAM allows for massive consolidation of enterprise workloads, reducing the overhead of managing multiple smaller instances.

The hardware profile of this server is designed for large-scale enterprise applications. Suitable workloads include in-memory databases, large-scale data analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive electronic design automation tasks.
